answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 41172 Country: India Title: Regarding Tarawih Question: My question pertains to tarawih offered in Ramadan because of a job in shifts. I miss a few of the tarawih prayer each year. Is it fine within Islamic purview? If not, what should I do? Secondly I have learnt from this site itself that the concept of giving money to the Hafiz who does the Imamah for tarawih is unlawful. Please elaborate a bit more on this issue. Answer ID: 41172 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1279/848/H=1433) (1) You should regularly offer tarawih in the entire Ramadan each year. It is misfortune to miss tarawih salah. (2) You have learnt the correct ruling. What more do you want to know? Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
